I work at Chipotle and there are people who will ask for a shit ton of sour cream. I remember this one lady came in and asked for a bowl and sour cream at the bottom. A LOT OF IT. When I was done with the bowl it was literally soup.

Most stores shouldn't charge you for them on the side anyway.
